title: Chevening Scholarship
description: A one-year taught master’s scholarship for emerging leaders who want to create lasting change in their home countries.
eligibility: Citizenship of a Chevening-eligible country
Undergraduate degree and required post-graduation work experience
Return to your home country for at least two years after the award
benefits: University tuition, subject to programme limits
note: MBA tuition is subject to a fee cap. Review the current eligibility rules before applying.

title: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
description: Postgraduate study in development-related programmes, connecting professional experience with sustainable economic and social progress.
eligibility: Graduates from eligible developing or newly industrialised countries
At least two years of professional experience
Meet the selected course’s academic and language requirements
benefits: Additional benefits depend on the programme

title: UBC International Scholars Program
description: For exceptional international school leavers with strong academics, community leadership, and significant financial need.
eligibility: Enter directly from an accredited secondary school
First undergraduate degree; study permit required
2027 applicants: high school graduation no earlier than June 2026
School nomination and demonstrated financial need
benefits: Financial support based on assessed need
note: Applications open 5 October 2026. Certain degree programmes are excluded; see the official page.

title: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
description: An entrance scholarship recognising outstanding academic achievement, creativity, and leadership among international students.
eligibility: International student beginning studies in September 2027
Final year of secondary school or graduated no earlier than June 2026
Nomination by your current secondary school
Students already in post-secondary study are ineligible
benefits: Full residence support for four years
note: School nomination: 9 October 2026. Admission application: 16 October 2026. Use the official deadline timezone.

title: KAIST International Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Study science, engineering, and technology at KAIST with tuition support and a monthly living allowance.
eligibility: Apply through International Student Admission
Meet KAIST admission requirements
Maintain the required GPA after the first year
note: Select KAIST Scholarship on the admission application. Full tuition does not necessarily cover all living expenses.

title: Global Korea Scholarship
provider: Government of the Republic of Korea
description: International degree opportunities at participating Korean universities, with embassy and university application tracks.
eligibility: Citizenship, age, and academic requirements depend on the annual call
Choose an eligible participating university and department
Apply through the correct embassy or university track
benefits: Study and living support under the annual guidelines
note: Check the current annual call for exact coverage, eligible countries, and deadlines.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
description: Graduate study and research in the United States for students, young professionals, and artists from participating countries.
eligibility: Non-U.S. applicants from participating countries
Eligibility and selection vary by home country
Apply through your Fulbright commission or U.S. embassy
benefits: Grant terms depend on your country and award
note: Current U.S. residency or enrollment may affect eligibility. Check your home-country programme.

title: MEXT Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Government-funded undergraduate study in Japan, usually including Japanese language preparation.
eligibility: Generally under 25 and completed 12 years of schooling
Meet the current nationality and academic conditions
Pass required screening and examinations
note: Embassy and university recommendation tracks have different requirements; follow the latest guidelines.

title: MEXT Research Student Scholarship
description: Support for international research students pursuing graduate-level work at Japanese universities.
eligibility: Generally under 35
Eligible for a Japanese graduate programme
Meet embassy or university recommendation requirements
note: Confirm eligible fields and the current call through your embassy or host university.

title: Australia Awards Scholarships
description: Study at participating Australian institutions and build skills connected to your home country’s development priorities.
eligibility: Be from an eligible participating country
Meet country-specific priority fields and conditions
Return home for the required period after the award
benefits: Contribution to living expenses and health cover
note: Study levels and available disciplines depend on the applicant’s country.

title: Schwarzman Scholars
description: A residential master’s in global affairs focused on leadership, China, and international understanding.
eligibility: Complete an undergraduate degree before enrollment
Meet the published age requirements
Demonstrate leadership and English proficiency
note: The 2027–2028 intake application window is closed. The next global cycle is April–September 2027 for August 2028 enrollment.

title: ETH Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme
description: Master’s support for academically excellent students, with mentorship and access to the ETH network.
eligibility: Apply to an eligible ETH master’s programme
Excellent bachelor’s results, typically top 10%
Submit the required pre-proposal and recommendations
note: For autumn 2027 onward, the living and study allowance is CHF 13,500 per semester. Current ETH master’s students and existing master’s degree holders are ineligible.

title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
amount: Up to three years of support
description: Graduate study at Stanford with multidisciplinary leadership development and a global community of scholars.
eligibility: Apply separately to Knight-Hennessy and an eligible Stanford graduate degree
Meet the published undergraduate-degree timing requirement
Demonstrate independence of thought, leadership, and civic commitment
note: Funding beyond three years depends on the graduate programme. Separate admission deadlines apply.

title: MPOWER Global Citizen Scholarship
description: Scholarship awards for international and DACA students enrolled at or accepted to an MPOWER-supported school in the United States or Canada.
eligibility: Accepted or enrolled full-time at an MPOWER-supported school
International or DACA student with qualifying legal study status
Meet the current official terms
benefits: No MPOWER loan required to apply
note: Confirm that your institution appears on the supported-school list. Award amounts follow the current call.
